mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( receiver_user_id, actor_user_id, notification_type, target_type, target_id, message, image_url, is_read, created_at ) VALUES ( #{receiverUserId}, #{actorUserId}, #{notificationType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{message}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isRead}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select:
SELECT n.notification_id,
n.actor_user_id, u.username AS actor_username, n.notification_type AS type, COALESCE(u.username, 'system') AS actor_name, u.profile_img AS actor_image_url, CASE WHEN n.notification_type = 'LIKE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS actor_count, n.target_type, n.target_id, CASE WHEN n.target_type = 'POST' THEN COALESCE( ( SELECT m.media_url FROM medias m WHERE m.post_id = n.target_id ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.media_id ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ), n.image_url ) ELSE n.image_url END AS target_image_url,
CASE WHEN n.actor_user_id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_FOLLOWING' WHEN n.actor_user_id = #{receiverUserId} THEN 'SELF' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_user_id = #{receiverUserId} AND f.following_user_id = n.actor_user_id ) THEN 'FOLLOWING' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow_requests fr WHERE fr.requester_user_id = #{receiverUserId} AND fr.receiver_user_id = n.actor_user_id AND fr.status = 'PENDING' ) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_FOLLOWING' END AS viewer_relation, CASE WHEN n.is_read = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_read_bool, n.created_at FROM ( SELECT base.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN base.notification_type = 'LIKE' THEN base.receiver_user_id || ':' || base.actor_user_id || ':' || base.notification_type || ':' || base.target_type || ':' || base.target_id ELSE TO_CHAR(base.notification_id) END ORDER BY base.created_at DESC, base.notification_id DESC ) AS event_rank FROM notifications base ) n LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.actor_user_id AND u.delete_at IS NULL WHERE n.receiver_user_id = #{receiverUserId} AND n.event_rank = 1 AND ( n.target_type IS NULL OR n.target_type != 'POST' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.post_id = n.target_id AND p.delete_at IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.notification_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT base.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN base.notification_type = 'LIKE' THEN base.receiver_user_id || ':' || base.actor_user_id || ':' || base.notification_type || ':' || base.target_type || ':' || base.target_id ELSE TO_CHAR(base.notification_id) END ORDER BY base.created_at DESC, base.notification_id DESC ) AS event_rank FROM notifications base ) n WHERE n.receiver_user_id = #{receiverUserId} AND n.event_rank = 1 AND n.is_read = 0 AND ( n.target_type IS NULL OR n.target_type != 'POST' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.post_id = n.target_id AND p.delete_at IS NULL ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_user_id = #{receiverUserId} AND is_read = 0
